notes: Synthetic attending take for LIDC finding 1 on the public 65-slice stack (money slice 34). No pixels and no PHI. The wav is a silent payload so CI can build the /api/transcribe-narration body without a microphone. The timed transcript is the STT stand-in; publishNarrationTake aligns it the same way the route does after Gemini.
transcript: Follow the vessels as you move. Keep the grey level here while you look. Come closer and hold that edge. The opening pass starts at the carina, then you leave it.
